verses.en: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.
verses.sm: Faauta, e pule le tupu ma le amiotonu, e pule foi alii ma le tonu.

verses.en: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
verses.sm: E fai foi le tagata e pei o se lafitaga i le matagi, ma se mea e malu ai i le afa; e pei o vaitafe i le nuu naumati, e pei o le paolo foi o le papa tele i le nuu ua le o i ai se vai.

verses.en: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.
verses.sm: E le faapouliuligia mata o e vaai; e uai mai foi taliga o e faalogo mai.

verses.en: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.
verses.sm: O loto foi o e oso popole e mafaufau e iloa ai; o laulaufaiva foi o e nanu e vave ona matala a latou upu.

verses.en: The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said to be bountiful.
verses.sm: E le toe ta‘uagaleleia le ua agaleaga, e le toe ta‘ua foi le ua mataoge, o le matamau.

verses.en: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the LORD, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
verses.sm: Aua e tautala le agaleaga i mea leaga, e sauni le agasala i lona loto, e fai amio faalematau, e tautala foi i mea sese i le ALII, ina ia faamatelaina le tagata ua fia ‘ai, ua aveesea foi le mea e inu i le ua fia inu.

verses.en: The instruments also of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right.
verses.sm: O togafiti a le mataoge e leaga ia; ua taupulepule ia i togafiti e faaumatia ai i upu pepelo e ua tigaina; e faaumatia foi e ua matitiva a o tautala i latou i upu tonu.

verses.en: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.
verses.sm: A o le ua matamau ua sauni e ia mea e matamau ai; o le matamau foi e faatumauina ai o ia.

verses.en: Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.
verses.sm: Ina tulai ia outou fafine o nonofo faafifilemu, ina faalogologo mai ia i loʻu leo; o outou tama fafine faatalanoa, uai mai ia o outou taliga i aʻu upu.

verses.en: Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.
verses.sm: A mavae le tausaga ma ni aso e tupu au, ona gatete ai lea outou fafine faatalanoa; aua e iu vale le fuata vine, e le 00 ina faaputuina ona fua.

verses.en: Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, and gird sackcloth upon your loins.
verses.sm: Ina gatete ia outou fafine o nonofo faafifilemu; ina tetemu ia outou fafine faatalanoa; to ese ia o outou ofu, ina faasau ia, ma ia lavalava outou i ie talatala.

verses.en: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
verses.sm: Latou te tu” i o latou susu, ona O le fanua matagofie, ona o vine fua tele.

verses.en: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city:
verses.sm: E tutupu mai i le laueleele o loʻu nuu o laau talatala ma laau tuitui, e tutupu lava i luga o fale ua outou fiafia i ai i le aai e olioli.

verses.en: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;
verses.sm: Auà e tuufua maota, e lafoaiina le aai sa taalili ai tagata; o Ofele ma le ‘olo e fai ma ana e faavavau; o le mea e fiafia i ai asini o le vao, o le mea e tataa ai le lafu;

verses.en: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.
verses.sm: seia liligi ifo i luga ia te i tatou le Agaga mai luga, ma ia avea ma fanua lafulemu le vao lafua, e ta‘ua foi le fanua lafulemu, o le vao matua.

verses.en: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.
verses.sm: Ona mau ai lea o le faamasinoga i le vao lafulafua, e nofo foi le amiotonu i le fanua lafulemu.

verses.en: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.
verses.sm: O le mea e tupu i le amiotonu o le manuia lea; e tupu mai foi i le amiotonu le filemu ma le saogalemu e faavavau.

verses.en: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;
verses.sm: E nonofo foi loʻu nuu i le mea e manuia ai, ma fale e saogalemu ai, ma mapusaga e filemu ai.

verses.en: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.
verses.sm: A e totò ifo le uatoʻa i le faapauna o le vao; e lafoina foi i lalo le aai i le mea maulalo.

verses.en: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass.
verses.sm: Amuia owon o e luluina saito i tafatafa o vai uma, o e tuuina atu i ai vae o povi ma asini.
